statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n h : ℕ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(h:ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun (n h : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1-h), a k * a (k+h); let model := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime k 30 then (30:ℝ)/8 else 0; let short := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => A n 0 a * V n 0 + 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min n ((L n)^2)), A n h a * V n h); let long := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc ((L n)^2+1) n, A n h a * V n h); ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ), U n a = short n a + long n a

plain_statement.zh: 将异常集能量精确展开成对角项与有序间距和
plain_statement.en: Exact lag expansion of masked energy

brief.zh: 在冻结的同一个集合上展开模平方。共轭的两项合成 2cos；正间距按 L² 分段。适用于任意实权，可分别代入两种权。
brief.en: Expand the finite squared norm on the same mask. Pair conjugates into twice the cosine moment. Separate positive lags at L² for arbitrary real weights.
